source.title: World Rubik's Cube Championship 2017 on July 13 - 16, 2017 in Paris, France
source.content: The [World Rubik's Cube Championship 2017](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/WC2017) will take place on July 13 - 16, 2017 in Paris, France. Check out the [World Rubik's Cube Championship 2017 website](http://www.rubiksworldparis2017.com) for more information and registration.

translation.title: 2017 年魔方世锦赛将于 7 月 13–16 日在法国巴黎举行
translation.content: [2017 年魔方世锦赛](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/WC2017)将于 2017 年 7 月 13–16 日在法国巴黎举行。更多信息及报名方式请见 [2017 年魔方世锦赛官网](http://www.rubiksworldparis2017.com)。
